content.title: About
content.content: Ground ham (680) is a ready‑to‑use product made from selected pork meat that has been cooked and finely minced to a uniform texture. It has a mild, slightly salty flavor and a soft consistency, ideal for sandwiches, salads, casseroles, and hot dishes.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Ground ham is widely used around the world as a quick source of protein.
During production small amounts of nitrites are added to preserve the pink color and extend shelf life.
Ham can be made from whole muscle cuts or a blend of trimmings, affecting taste and texture.
Thermal processing makes the product safe to eat without further cooking.
Ham is a common topping for pizza, omelets, and rolls.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Ham provides high‑quality animal protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: It supplies vitamins B1, B2, B6 and B12, which support energy metabolism.

items.title: Source of iron and zinc
items.content: These minerals help maintain immune function and oxygen transport.

items.title: Contains selenium
items.content: Selenium acts as an antioxidant and supports thyroid health.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Ham is often salty, so people with hypertension should limit intake.

items.title: Nitrites and preservatives
items.content: Some varieties contain nitrites, which may be undesirable in large amounts.

items.title: Pork allergy
items.content: A minority of individuals may be allergic or intolerant to pork.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Ham is relatively calorie‑dense, so portion control is recommended.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Ham can be eaten straight from the package, added to sandwiches, salads, pastas, casseroles, omelets, and soups. It is also used as a filling for rolls and pizza. If desired, briefly warm it in a pan or microwave.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store ham in an airtight container in the refrigerator at 0 °C to +4 °C. Once opened, keep it for up to 5 days. For longer storage, freeze at –18 °C, where it retains quality for up to 2 months. Discard any product with off‑odors or discoloration.
